data.name: NY Carbon
data.description: NY Carbon is a small Saugerties, NY-based commercial biochar producer using locally sourced woody waste feedstock via pyrolysis. It serves as the exclusive biochar supplier for the Hudson Valley Biochar Pioneers program (4 Corners Carbon Coalition, Terraset, Sustainable Hudson Valley, Cornell Cooperative Extension), which equipped 14 farms with biochar in spring 2025.
